records.name: Angular UAutoComplete
records.purpose: Text input with a consumer-driven suggestion list: the component emits a search request and renders whatever suggestions array the consumer supplies in an overlay listbox, selecting one option as the form value.
records.surface: Extends UBaseInput (which extends UBaseEditableHolder and UModelHolder) so it inherits the disabled signal input, $disabled, modelValue/$filled and the ControlValueAccessor methods writeValue/registerOnChange/registerOnTouched/setDisabledState. The inherited UBaseInput inputs variant, size, inputSize, pattern, min, max, step, minlength and maxlength are not read anywhere in this component's source; fluid is consumed only through hasFluid in classesParams. Standalone, OnPush, ViewEncapsulation.None; provides NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR via useExisting with multi and overrides writeControlValue. Selector u-autocomplete; componentName autocomplete. Signal inputs: suggestions (unknown[], default []), optionLabel (string or function), minLength (default 1, numberAttribute), delay (default 300 ms, numberAttribute), ariaLabel, inputId, placeholder, loading (booleanAttribute), emptyMessage (default "No results found"), showEmptyMessage (default true). There are no optionValue, optionDisabled, filter, showClear or multiple inputs. Outputs: completeMethod (UAutoCompleteCompleteEvent {originalEvent, query}), onSelect (UAutoCompleteSelectEvent {originalEvent, value}), onFocus (Event), onBlur (Event), onClear (void). onFocus and onBlur emit a newly constructed synthetic Event (new Event("focus") / new Event("blur")), not the DOM event. Template: one native input type=text with role=combobox and aria-autocomplete=list, bound to [value]=inputValue(), placeholder, id (inputId), disabled attribute, aria-label (ariaLabel), aria-expanded (overlayVisible) and aria-activedescendant (id_option_N when focusedOptionIndex is not -1, else null); there is no aria-controls and no aria-haspopup. A loader span (aria-hidden) renders while loading() is true. The overlay (UOverlay directive, appendTo body, rendered only while overlayVisible) holds a ul role=listbox with id <id>_list and li role=option elements (id <id>_option_N, aria-selected from isSelected, click selects, mouseenter sets the focused index); when suggestions is empty and showEmptyMessage() is true an li role=option shows emptyMessage. The instance id is u_autocomplete_<n> from a static counter and is not applied to the host. Behaviour: onInput clears any pending timer; an empty query writes null, calls onModelChange(null), emits onClear and hides; a query with length >= minLength resets the focused index to -1 and schedules setTimeout(delay()) that emits completeMethod({originalEvent, query}) and then sets overlayVisible true; a shorter non-empty query hides. Typing alone never changes modelValue; it changes only on option select, an emptied input or writeValue. The pending timer is cleared only by the next onInput (there is no ngOnDestroy), so a scheduled search can still emit and open the overlay after blur or after a selection. onInputBlur calls onModelTouched, hide() and then emits onBlur; onModelTouched is not called by option selection. Keyboard (event.code, ignored with preventDefault when disabled): ArrowDown/ArrowUp act only while the overlay is visible and wrap modulo the suggestion count (ArrowDown from the last goes to 0; ArrowUp from index <= 0 goes to count-1); with an empty suggestions array ArrowDown sets the focused index to 0, and a following Enter calls onOptionSelect with suggestions()[0] which is undefined. Enter/NumpadEnter act only while visible, select the focused option when the index is not -1, and always preventDefault; Escape hides and preventDefault only while visible. There is no Home/End/Tab handling. onOptionSelect writes the option itself as modelValue (no optionValue mapping), calls onModelChange, sets the native input value to the option label, emits onSelect({originalEvent, value}) and hides. getOptionLabel returns "" for null/undefined, calls a function optionLabel, reads a string optionLabel from an object via String(obj[key] ?? ""), otherwise returns a string as is or String(option). isSelected compares modelValue() === option by identity. writeControlValue calls setModelValue(value) and sets the native input value to the label. Overlay composition: UOverlay (ng-core) moves the element to document.body and assigns a z-index while visible; the component binds only [visible] and appendTo and does not bind visibleChange. Nothing in autocomplete.ts or overlay.ts registers an outside-click listener or positions the panel; the CSS positions it absolute at top 0, left 0. Public API: UAutoComplete (class), UAutoCompleteCompleteEvent and UAutoCompleteSelectEvent (types). Owned source-only declarations: AutoCompleteClassesParams (filled, invalid, fluid, disabled, focused, selected) and autoCompleteStyleModule {css, classes} in autocomplete-style.ts; neither is a barrel export. Style facts: host class from cx('root') with filled, fluid (hasFluid) and disabled params only; classes.root can emit u-autocomplete u-component, p-filled, p-invalid, u-autocomplete-fluid and p-disabled, but invalid is never passed so p-invalid is never emitted, and the CSS in autocomplete-style.ts has no rule for p-filled, p-invalid or p-disabled. classes.option accepts selected but optionClassesParams passes only focused, so u-autocomplete-option-selected (which has a CSS rule) is never emitted. Class keys: root, pcInputText, loader, overlay, list, option, emptyMessage. Theme: the Aura components registry key autocomplete (packages/themes/src/presets/aura/index.ts, preset file autocomplete.ts) equals componentName autocomplete. Root @ultimate/ng re-exports this family (barrel line export * from "@ultimate/ng/autocomplete"); it is also exposed via the @ultimate/ng/autocomplete manifest subpath. No outputs besides those listed; no ngOnInit/ngOnDestroy override, HostListener, document listener, ContentChild/ContentChildren or virtual scroll (Scroller) usage exists in autocomplete.ts. dt and unstyled are inherited UBaseComponent inputs and nothing in this component reads them. Component-metadata: no component-metadata record exists for autocomplete (packages/component-metadata/src/records has button, checkbox, dialog, menu, paginator, scroller, table, tooltip only). Styles: No dedicated @ultimate/uix-styles/autocomplete export exists; the CSS is hand-ported inside autocomplete-style.ts. The generated autocomplete.spec.ts and autocomplete.stories.ts are excluded supporting files.

records.purpose: Multi-value dropdown: a combobox trigger opens an overlay listbox of checkbox options with optional select-all, filtering and clear; the model is an array of option values.

records.name: Angular UCascadeSelect
records.purpose: Single-leaf dropdown over nested option groups: a combobox trigger opens an overlay tree where clicking a group drills into its submenu and clicking a leaf selects it.
records.surface: Extends UBaseEditableHolder directly (not UBaseInput), so it inherits the disabled signal input, $disabled, modelValue/$filled and the ControlValueAccessor methods writeValue/registerOnChange/registerOnTouched/setDisabledState, and has no fluid, variant, size, pattern, min, max or step inputs. Standalone, OnPush, ViewEncapsulation.None; provides NG_VALUE_ACCESSOR via useExisting with multi and overrides writeControlValue. Selector u-cascade-select; componentName cascadeselect (the registry key differs from the folder and selector names). Imports UOverlay and NgTemplateOutlet. Signal inputs: options, optionLabel, optionValue, optionGroupChildren (default "items", names the child array property), optionDisabled, placeholder, emptyMessage. There are no ariaLabel, inputId, filter or showClear inputs. Outputs: onChange (UCascadeSelectChangeEvent {originalEvent, value}), onFocus (Event, the real DOM event), onBlurEmit (Event, synthetic new Event("blur")); there is no onClear. onChange is emitted only when a leaf is clicked. Tree model: a non-exported ProcessedOption {option, key, parentKey, children} is built recursively by buildTree (key is the index at the root and <parentKey>_<index> below); an option is a group only when option[optionGroupChildren()] is a non-empty array. findPathToValue matches leaf nodes only, so a group's own value is never matched. The label is placeholder() ?? "" when modelValue is null/undefined or matches no leaf, otherwise the matched leaf's label; the placeholder class applies only when modelValue() == null. Template: trigger span role=combobox with aria-haspopup=tree, aria-expanded and aria-disabled and tabindex; no aria-label, aria-controls or aria-activedescendant. The overlay renders a recursive ng-template #sublist through NgTemplateOutlet: ul role=tree (cx('list') at the root, cx('sublist') nested) with li role=treeitem (aria-selected bound on every item and true only for the selected leaf, aria-expanded bound to isActiveNode for groups and null for leaves) whose inner div cx('optionContent') takes the click and mouseenter handlers; onOptionMouseEnter is an intentional no-op (its body is only void _node). A group icon span is aria-hidden. The empty-message li role=treeitem renders only for an empty list. Behaviour: show() opens the overlay and, when modelValue != null and a leaf matches, sets activeOptionPath to the ancestor keys of that leaf; hide() clears it. onOptionClick returns for disabled options (no drill, no select); for a group it collapses an active node (removing its key and descendant keys) or expands it with [...path.filter(key => key !== node.parentKey), node.key]; read literally, expanding a group below the root level removes its parent's key from the path, and the template renders a node's children only while isActiveNode(node) is true, so by reading the source the parent's submenu (which contains the expanded group) stops rendering (not executed); expanding a root group filters nothing out because root parentKey is "", so sibling root groups can stay open together. A leaf click writes the value, calls onModelChange and onModelTouched, emits onChange and hides. The trigger keydown (ignored when disabled) opens on Enter/NumpadEnter/Space/ArrowDown when closed (preventDefault is called even when already open), closes on Escape while open and closes on Tab; options have no tabindex and no keyboard path selects or navigates options. onOptionClick does not check $disabled().
